messages:
alex_finance: Quick flag — invoice INV-2026-042 shows a weird split for OrbisAI's reserved commit. Looks like ~40% of their EU reserved capacity got charged as a burst/overage on our account after a regional failover on 2026-03-15. Can ops/finance confirm before we issue any provisional credit?

nina_ops: Hmm, I see the trace. Failover at 03:12 UTC routed to our US pool because EU pool hit maintenance window. Billing tags did not carry "failover_protection" through for that tenant. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

alex_finance: Ugh. Do you have the allocation lines? I need the invoice line ids and the raw meter rows to match to INV-2026-042 lines 17-22.

nina_ops: Pasted small extract from our metering DB: 
```
customer,region,commit_id,usage_sec,charge_cents,tag
orbisai,eu,commit-OR-1,0,0,reserved
orbisai,us,commit-OR-1,14400,28200,failover_temp
orbisai,us,commit-OR-1,3600,7050,burst
```
Those second/third rows are the problematic ones — routed to us and billed as burst because tag didn't map to reserved.

jamal_sales: FYI customer triggered the failover during their incident window — they didn't expect to be billed for failover capacity. They already pinged their AM. We usually do a goodwill in these cases if it's clearly our routing/tagging bug.

karen_recon: From finance side, provisional credit ok but need proposed amount and GL code. Rough calc = 28200 + 7050 = 35250 cents => $352.50. Suggest provisional credit for the billed overage lines (invoice lines 18-19). Approve?

alex_finance: Proposed provisional credit = $352.50 credited to INV-2026-042 pending full reconciliation. GL: 6102 (Provisionals). Need ops to confirm we'll re-run billing job after fix so we don't double-credit.

nina_ops: I'll patch the tag-mapping rule to include failover_protection for OrbisAI's commit_id and reprocess the affected window. Command I will run: `./billing-reprocess --customer orbisai --start 2026-03-15T03:00Z --end 2026-03-15T04:00Z`

billing-bot: run accepted by infra: "billing-reprocess job queued (job_id: br-20260315-443). Estimated completion: 4m." :robot_face:

jamal_sales: Approving provisional credit up to $400 as goodwill so CS can respond immediately. :thumbsup:

karen_recon: Noted. Alex, please create the provisional credit memo and set status = "pending-reprocess". Once billing job finishes and we confirm the lines moved back to reserved, we'll finalize the credit (or reverse if re-billing absorbs it).

alex_finance: Will create memo now and tag with INV-2026-042 / job br-20260315-443. Thanks all.

nina_ops: Job finished: "br-20260315-443: 3 meter rows reclassified, 0 duplicates, 1 invoice re-aggregation scheduled." I'll post follow-up when invoice re-agg completes.

billing-bot: invoice-agg triggered (agg_id: agg-20260315-77).

karen_recon: Once re-agg posts, I'll reconcile and either finalize the provisional credit or adjust. Keeping this thread open. :eyes:
